description: Adds project-level skills. ``add-skill``, ``remove-skill``, ``update-skill``, ``list-installed-skills``, ``check-skill-updates``, and ``aws configure agent-toolkit`` accept ``--project`` to act on skills in the current directory, or ``--global`` for skills in the home directory. ``list-installed-skills`` and ``check-skill-updates`` show both, with a new ``scope`` field. ``aws configure agent-toolkit --project`` also configures the AWS MCP server in each agent's project MCP config. Automatic updates also keep the AWS skills of the project an agent session starts in up to date. ``add-skill``, ``remove-skill``, and ``update-skill`` accept ``--no-follow-symlinks`` to skip skills under a symbolic link.
